profile.name: Manuel Bolaños
profile.tagline: A decade shipping the web stack — now wiring LLMs and microcontrollers into the loop.
profile.summary: Full-stack web developer with over a decade of experience and 200+ delivered projects, with a growing side interest in embedded systems and IoT. My core is the web stack — PHP, Laravel, WordPress, React and JavaScript — with deep experience in CRM-driven enterprise development: custom solutions on SugarCRM, custom-endpoint integrations connecting the CRM to e-commerce platforms and third-party systems, and marketing automation on ActiveCampaign. I have delivered large-scale billing, ticketing, scheduling and queue-management systems for the automotive, security and healthcare sectors, and I currently work on WordPress platforms for U.S. law firms in the legal marketing space. Along the way I have led teams as Scrum Master and Technical Lead under agile methodologies, and I actively integrate AI agents and LLMs into real products.
profile.hybrid: Equally comfortable architecting a Laravel application, shipping a professional website, or wiring an LLM into an existing workflow.
